channel.title: Business services: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the business services sector.

item.title: NGeneBio: NGeneBio's board decided a KRW 6.0bn third-party allotment of 6,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 per share to its largest shareholder.
NGeneBio: NGeneBio will issue 2,000,000 new common shares at KRW 1,000 to its largest shareholder via third-party allotment, raising KRW 2.0bn for debt repayment.
Gridwiz: Gridwiz decided to absorb its wholly owned subsidiary IDR Service in a small-scale merger, with the merger date set for January 1, 2027.
HS Ad: HS Ad reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 87.5bn and operating profit of KRW 7.1bn, up 36.57% year on year.
